content.text: The notifying thread does not need to hold the lock on the same mutex as the one held by the waiting thread(s); in fact doing so is a pessimization, since the notified thread would immediately block again, waiting for the notifying thread to release the lock.
added helgrind suppression and documented the reasons for this approach (pessimization avoidance)
there remains this sort of issue, and we have a helgrind supression for it, but the supression still exists so the bug should remain open til helgrind is fixed (or the stroika code).
MAYBE reproduced something similar on Ubutnu 20.04
